title: Top 20 Must Know Tips: RuneScape DragonWilds
author: AnomalyMe
description:
Think you’re ready for the Dragonwilds? Think again. In this video, we’re breaking down 20 essential tips to help you master the most dangerous zone in the game. Whether you’re hunting for rare drops or just trying to survive your first trip, these strategies will give you the edge you need.
📢 Share your thoughts in the comments
👍 Like if this helped you
🔔 Subscribe for more game reviews and opinions

#gaming #gamingtips #dragonwilds #smallyoutuber #gamergirl #mmorpg #rpg #trending #survivalgame

transcript.text: Here are 20 of the most valuable tips for Runescape Dragon Wilds that will upgrade you from being a Dragon Wild's
Bob to a Dragon Wild's boss. I recommend that you watch right to the end because I have left my very best [music] tips
for last. In the recent December update, crop plot farming was introduced into the game. You'll unlock farming tools,
potions, and spells, [music] which is all pretty standard. However, one thing you may pass over is the fact that
certain plants will grow better in different crop plots. Basically, [music] seeds found in Brimmore will grow best
in ash plots, seeds from Gornfell in oak plots, and seeds from fell hollow in the
willow plots. When caring for plants, it can go unnoticed that you don't actually have to fully water and fertilize your
crops. Just doing a small amount is enough to keep your crops growing. Some food recipes give a buff that can
increase stats [music] such as health, stamina, and poison resistance. Don't sleep on this tip because as you
progress, these food and drink recipes can really impact whether you can beat certain baddies or explore in higher
tier zones. Potions also fall under this category. Make them, use them, you will need them. You can find your unlocked
potion recipes in your journal and craft them in the cooking pot. Use charcoal instead of ash logs. It cooks food
faster and is unlocked [music] through the kiln. If you're not interested in having war bands or the dragon attacking
your base, then you're going to want to build in the tier one zone. This is in the temple woods. Anywhere above tier
one will be prone to these attacks. And the difficulty of these raids increase the higher the level of the zone. If
your base is getting attacked by a war band, go outside. The last thing that you want is the goons and goblins
damaging your base. If the goons and goblins do end up damaging your base, you can toggle the building repair mode
to check the damage and patch it all up. When building, you can use a spell called eye of Oculus to basically move
freely and place building pieces in those hard-to-reach places. Some of the crafting benches can only be placed
outside and others have to be inside. Definitely take this into consideration when building your base. If you sleep
through the night after putting on a bunch of items to craft, it'll all be crafted and ready to collect when your
character wakes up. When you're ready to start exploring new areas of the map, you should place a load stone at your
base and take the resources to place one in the new zone. This means that when you die, and you probably will, you'll
have a faster way to get back to your gravestone. I also use load stones to farm resources by placing them near
decent resource [music] deposits. You can use the vaults in the starting zone to get the resources you need to craft
the load stones. Vaults do respawn after a day or two, so you [music] can essentially farm these. When exploring
new areas, you will want your gear to be at least the same tier level as the zone you're exploring in, or preferably
higher. Also, it's cheaper to repair your armor and weapons using the repair tab in the crafting benches rather than
crafting new sets. Utilize spells in battle. Use the shield spell and the spells to enchant your weapons. You'll
definitely want to level up your magic skills early on in the game and keep leveling [music] it. This was a mistake
I made which then left me scrambling to level up my magic in time to use in specific fights later in the game.
Unlock the ward stone level [music] two as fast as you can. This increases your shield so much and it's worth the slight
bit of extra effort to find the resources that you'll need. Look for the blue tree in the fractured plains to
find these resources. There is a spell called summon shelter. This will create a cozy little tent that will allow you
to regenerate your strength stat or [music] sleep through the night. Goblins and gar are more active at night, so
this can be very useful when exploring. I just want to note that you can't respawn at the scent if you die after
casting the spell. [music] Each weapon has an attack combination and also a special attack, [music] so be sure to
remember to use it. Okay, so this is my last tip and by far the most useful tip. Use your journal to check enemy
weaknesses. This is found underneath the world factions tab and is a super underrated way to destroy absolutely
everything that you come up against in battle. All right, so if you enjoyed today's video, don't forget to like,
comment, [music] and subscribe. And if I missed anything, if you have a tip that
you think should have been in this list, please drop it down in the comments below. Thank you guys for watching and
I'll see you guys in the next one. Bye guys.

comments.author: @highbrednxtus
comments.text:
Highly recommend always attuning runes instead of just crafting. You get bonus runes from the mini game and it takes about 15-20 seconds to complete.
Always attune about 25 essence at a time, if you mess up you don't waste too much but if you nail the mini game on hard then you should be crafting 100 or more bonus runes per attunement.

If you're looking for some quick runes and essence, farm goblins as they'll drop these and other good resources.

Definitely highly recommend almost always hitting the essence "veins" (don't remember what they're called) to attune specific elements. Rune essence takes up basic inventory space and weight while runes do not.

comments.author: @highbrednxtus
comments.text: Oh and I haven't verified but attunement also probably gives more XP than crafting?

comments.author: @highbrednxtus
comments.text: processing 25 essence at a time also gives you a better idea of which other runes you want to attune instead of just dumping them all into one.
